title: A linear list-coloring bound in terms of the Hadwiger number
summary: We prove that every finite nonempty graph G satisfies $`\chi_{\mathrm{list}}(G)\le C h(G)`$ for an absolute integer C , where $`h(G)`$ is the largest order of a clique minor. This resolves the Linear List Hadwiger conjecture affirmatively.
family_title: Graph coloring, clique minors, and Colin de Verdière invariants

review.reason: Proves list chromatic number is linearly bounded by the Hadwiger number.
